subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: For #57091, should the close condition be a new `openclaw skills lint` plus status failure data, or must ordinary `skills list`/`skills check`/gateway status and Web UI also show malformed SKILL.md diagnostics before the issue closes?
rationale: Current main proves the diagnostic gap remains, while PR #92028 provides a plausible lint/status implementation but leaves the user-visible scope of the original request partially open.

options.title: Accept CLI lint plus status data first
options.body: Treat PR #92028's loader failure data and `openclaw skills lint` as the core fix, then track Web or list/check presentation as follow-up only if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require normal status/list/check visibility
options.body: Do not close #57091 until skipped SKILL.md diagnostics appear in the everyday skill status/list/check path, not only in a separate lint command.

options.title: Expand to Web diagnostics too
options.body: Require the Web skills surface to display failed SKILL.md candidates as part of the initial fix, increasing scope but matching the issue's full UX request.

recommendation.title: Accept CLI lint plus status data first
recommendation.body: Treat PR #92028's loader failure data and `openclaw skills lint` as the core fix, then track Web or list/check presentation as follow-up only if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills loader/status history makes this the best available routing owner for deciding the accepted core diagnostic surface.
